availability.message: Human NORMAL Origins: Veteran levels 1–3 (three manually adjudicated doctrines), or Hive Scum level 1. Twitchy and reviewed equipment branches only. Suppressing Fire is unavailable pending a ruling.
Rare Origins require trusted GM approval and are unavailable for self-service creation.
Limited Origins require combination-specific campaign approval and are unavailable for self-service creation.
Zealot, Arbites, psychic paths, non-Humans and other levels remain uncertified. Older characters retain their original profile.

species.name: Human
species.description:
3.1 Human
Humans are the baseline of the Imperium: adaptable, 
ambitious, fragile, and dangerously determined.
Ability Scores: +2 to one ability score and +1 to 
another.
Size: Medium.
Speed: 30 ft.
Available Classes: Veteran, Zealot, Psyker, Arbites 
Enforcer, Hive Scum.
3.1.1 Human Traits
Imperial Adaptability: Gain proficiency in one skill of 
your choice.
Broad Training: Gain one additional weapon, tool, or 
language proficiency.
Faith, Fear, or Discipline: Once per long rest, when you 
fail a saving throw, you may reroll it. You must
use the new result.

origins.name: Hiveborn
origins.description:
4.1 Hiveborn
Raised in the brutal density of a hive city.
Allowed Species: Human, Ratling, rare Ogryn.
Skill Proficiency: Choose one from Deception, Insight, 
Intimidation, Sleight of Hand, or Stealth.
Crowd Rat: You ignore difficult terrain caused by 
crowds, rubble, cramped spaces, pipes, gantries, and
dense urban clutter.
Seen Worse: You have advantage on saving throws 
against fear caused by gore, violence, intimidation,
or battlefield horror.

origins.name: Shrine Worlder
origins.description:
4.2 Shrine Worlder
Raised in devotion, ritual, sacrifice, and Imperial worship.
Allowed Species: Human, rare Ratling.
Skill Proficiency: Religion and either Persuasion or 
Intimidation.
Litany of Resolve: Once per long rest, you can give 
yourself or one ally within 30 ft. advantage on a Wisdom 
saving throw.
Sacred Hatred: Once per turn, when you damage a 
heretic, daemon, mutant, witch, traitor, or xenos with
a weapon attack or class feature, you deal an additional 
1d4 + 1 radiant damage.
This damage represents zeal, ritual fury, and trained 
hatred rather than true divine magic.

origins.name: Penal Worlder
origins.description:
4.3 Penal Worlder
A convict, survivor, conscript, or former prisoner.
Allowed Species: Human, Ogryn, Ratling.
Skill Proficiency: Survival and one of Athletics, 
Deception, or Intimidation.
Hard Time: You have advantage on saving throws 
against exhaustion caused by forced marches,
starvation, poor conditions, or sleep deprivation.
Dirty Survival: Once per long rest, when you are 
reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you
may drop to 1 hit point instead.

origins.name: Voidborn
origins.description:
4.4 Voidborn
Born aboard a voidship, orbital station, warship, pilgrim 
vessel, or ancient wreck.
Allowed Species: Human, Ratling, rare Ogryn.
Skill Proficiency: Choose one from Acrobatics, 
Perception, Investigation, or Technology.
Void Legs: You have advantage on checks and saving 
throws to avoid being knocked prone or moved
against your will.
Shipwise: You are proficient with basic voidship 
procedures, airlocks, auspex consoles, pressure doors,
and shipboard emergency systems.

origins.name: Forge World
origins.description:
4.5 Forge World
Raised among manufactorums, machine temples, data-
vaults, and sacred industry.
Allowed Species: Human, Skitarii.
Skill Proficiency: Investigation and Technology.
Machine Rites: You can perform basic maintenance on 
weapons, armour, augmetics, cogitators, and
power systems.
Logic Before Fear: Once per long rest, you may gain 
advantage on a saving throw against fear, panic, or
psychic manipulation.

origins.name: Schola Progenium
origins.description:
4.6 Schola Progenium
Raised in harsh Imperial institutions to become a soldier, 
judge, officer, priest, or specialist.
Allowed Species: Human.
Skill Proficiency: Choose one from History or Religion, 
and one from Intimidation or Persuasion.
Drilled Obedience: You have advantage on saving 
throws against fear while following a direct order,
holding formation, or protecting an Imperial objective.
Imperial Education: You can identify major Imperial 
organisations, ranks, symbols, rites, and
procedures.

origins.name: Militarum Regiment
origins.description:
4.7 Militarum Regiment
Formerly attached to an Imperial Guard force, auxiliary 
formation, or battlefield logistics unit.
Allowed Species: Human, Ogryn, Ratling, limited 
Skitarii.
Skill Proficiency: Choose one from Athletics or Survival, 
and gain Perception.
Squad Drill: Before initiative is rolled, choose one ally 
within 5 ft of you who can see or hear you. You
and that chosen ally each gain +1 to initiative for that 
combat. You must choose the ally before anyone
rolls initiative. If no ally is within 5 ft when initiative is 
called, this feature provides no benefit.
Field Discipline: Once per short rest, you may reroll a 
failed saving throw against Suppression.

origins.name: Underhive
origins.description:
4.8 Underhive
Raised below the proper world, among gangs, sump-rats, 
chem dens, scavvers, and forgotten habs.
Allowed Species: Human, Ratling.
Skill Proficiency: Choose two from Deception, 
Intimidation, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, and Survival.
Black-Market Instinct: You know how to locate illegal 
goods, smugglers, fences, and information
brokers in hive settlements.
Never Fight Fair: Once per short rest, when you hit a 
creature that has not acted yet in combat, deal
additional damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

classes.name: Veteran
classes.description:
11.1 Veteran
Professional soldier, marksman, squad leader, or hardened guardsman.
Allowed Species: Human, Ratling.
Hit Die: d10.
Primary Abilities: Dexterity, Wisdom.
Saving Throws: Dexterity, Wisdom.
Armour: Light, medium, flak, carapace.
Weapons: Simple weapons, martial melee weapons, pistols, basic firearms, grenades.

classes.name: Hive Scum
classes.description:
11.6 Hive Scum
Gang fighter, smuggler, knife-rat, scavver, bounty runner, or underhive survivor.
Allowed Species: Human, Ratling.
Hit Die: d8.
Primary Abilities: Dexterity, Charisma.
Saving Throws: Dexterity, Charisma.
Armour: Light armour, flak armour.
Weapons: Pistols, basic firearms, knives, improvised weapons, and grenades.

featureCatalogue.name: Ranger Training
featureCatalogue.description:
Gain proficiency in Stealth and Perception. You also gain 
proficiency with Aeldari weapons and ranger weave.

featureCatalogue.name: Shuriken Grace
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per turn, when you hit with a shuriken, ranger, or 
Aeldari blade weapon after moving at least 10 ft, add 
+1d6 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Death from Elsewhere
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per short rest, when you hit a creature that cannot 
see you, turn the hit into a critical hit.

featureCatalogue.name: Perfect Motion
featureCatalogue.description:
When you move at least 20 ft on your turn, opportunity 
attacks against you have disadvantage, and your next 
weapon hit before the end of the turn deals +1d6 
damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Vanish Beyond Sight
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per long rest, as a bonus action, become invisible 
until the start of your next turn or until you make an 
attack. This is a psychic-adjacent Aeldari trick, not a 
normal Imperial stealth field.

featureCatalogue.description:
Outcast Path Feature

Your Death from Elsewhere 
feature recharges when you roll 
initiative if you have no uses 
remaining.
Corsair
After scoring a critical hit, you may 
make one pistol or blade attack as 
a bonus action.
Shadow Guide
Once per short rest, you and up to 
two allies within 30 ft may move 10 
ft without provoking opportunity 
attacks.

featureCatalogue.name: Mythic Outcast
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, you gain +10 ft speed, 
advantage on Stealth checks, and your first
weapon hit each turn deals +1d10 damage if you moved 
before attacking.

featureCatalogue.description: Progression table entry: Ability Score Improvement / Talent. Full clause mapping requires review; do not infer effects.

featureCatalogue.name: Pathless Perfection
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per round, when you move at least 10 ft before 
attacking, you may add +1d4 to either the
attack roll or the damage roll after seeing the d20.

featureCatalogue.name: Path Feature

Ranger Your attacks from hiding score a 
critical hit on 19-20.
Outcast Path Feature
Corsair
After you move 5 ft from your 
Corsair feature, your next attack 
before your next turn gains +1d6 
damage.
Shadow Guide
Allies moved by your Path Feature 
may also ignore difficult terrain 
until your next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Ghostwalk
featureCatalogue.description:
You may Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action if 
you are wearing light or Aeldari armour.

featureCatalogue.name: Legend of the Wandering Path
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, you may use Ghostwalk 
without a bonus action on each of your
turns. During this time, your first hit each turn against a 
creature that cannot see you becomes
a critical hit on a roll of 19-20.

featureCatalogue.description:

your first ranged attack this turn 
gains +2 to hit.
Corsair
You gain proficiency with pistols 
and blades. After making a 
weapon attack, move 5 ft without 
provoking opportunity attacks.
Shadow Guide
Gain expertise in Stealth or 
Survival. You have advantage on 
checks to navigate ruins, 
wilderness, alien structures, and

At level 5, you can attack twice when you take the Attack 
action.

featureCatalogue.name: Unseen Shot
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per short rest, when you hit a creature while hidden 
or heavily obscured, add 2d6 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Path Feature
featureCatalogue.description:
Outcast Path Feature
Ranger Your attacks with Accurate Aeldari 
weapons ignore light cover.
Corsair Your Shuriken Grace damage 
applies to pistol attacks.
Outcast Path Feature
Shadow Guide
Allies within 10 ft of you ignore 
non-magical difficult terrain while 
travelling carefully.

featureCatalogue.name: Webway Instinct
featureCatalogue.description:
You have advantage on saving throws against being 
surprised, lost, restrained by terrain, or trapped by 
mundane mechanisms.

featureCatalogue.name: Aeldari Outcast training and hit die
featureCatalogue.description:
11.11 Aeldari Outcast
An Aeldari ranger, exile, corsair-adjacent wanderer, pathless scout, or alien marksman pursuing a hidden agenda.
Allowed Species: Aeldari only.
Hit Die: d8.
Primary Abilities: Dexterity, Wisdom.
Saving Throws: Dexterity, Wisdom.
Armour: Aeldari mesh, ranger weave, light armour.
Weapons: Aeldari weapons, pistols, blades, sniper weapons.

featureCatalogue.name: Runes of Battle
featureCatalogue.description:
You learn psychic powers from the Universal, Divination, 
Telekinesis, and Warlock power lists. You may
learn Pyromancy only if the GM allows a destructive 
battle-seer interpretation. You cannot learn
Malefic powers.
The Aeldari Warlock level table lists your Minor, 
Standard, and Major powers known. You learn powers
from your allowed lists as you gain levels.

featureCatalogue.name: Witchblade Training
featureCatalogue.description:
You may use your psychic ability modifier for attack and 
damage rolls with witchblades and singing
spears.

featureCatalogue.name: War-Rune Mastery
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per short rest, when you cast a Minor or Standard 
power from the Warlock, Divination, or Telekinesis lists, 
you may target one additional creature within 10 ft of the 
original target. The second target takes half damage; if 
the power has no damage, the secondary effect lasts no 
longer than until the start of your next turn unless the GM 
rules the effect cannot sensibly be split.

featureCatalogue.name: Major Rune Access
featureCatalogue.description:
You may learn one Major Power from the Universal, 
Divination, Telekinesis, or Warlock lists. You
cannot learn Malefic Major Powers.

featureCatalogue.description: Progression table entry: Ability Score Improvement / Talent. Full clause mapping requires review; do not infer effects.

featureCatalogue.name: Fate Splitter
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per long rest, when a creature you can see within 
60 ft makes an attack roll, saving throw, or
ability check, roll 1d6 and either add or subtract it from 
the result.

featureCatalogue.name: Path Feature
featureCatalogue.description:
Warlock Path Feature
Seer of Battle
Once per short rest, give one ally 
advantage on an attack, save, or 
check as a reaction.
Warlock Path Feature
Storm Warlock Your first damaging psychic power 
each combat deals +1d8 damage.
Spirit Guardian
Allies protected by your Rune 
Ward also gain advantage on the 
next fear or psychic saving throw 
they make before your next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Storm of Runes
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, your first psychic power 
each turn costs 1 less Warp Pressure, minimum
1. If Perils triggers during this minute, add +2 to the 
severity roll after all reductions.

featureCatalogue.name: Ability Score Improvement / Talent
featureCatalogue.description: Progression table entry: Ability Score Improvement / Talent. Full clause mapping requires review; do not infer effects.

featureCatalogue.name: Spirit-Rune Focus
featureCatalogue.description:
Choose one Warlock, Divination, or Telekinesis power 
you know. Once per short rest, you may
cast it with its Warp Pressure cost reduced by 1, 
minimum 1.

featureCatalogue.name: Path Feature
featureCatalogue.description:
Warlock Path Feature
Seer of Battle
Your reaction advantage may be 
used after the d20 is rolled but 
before the result is declared.
Storm Warlock Your Storm Warlock push 
increases to 10 ft.
Spirit Guardian
When Rune Ward protects an ally, 
one hostile creature within 30 ft 
has disadvantage on its next 
psychic saving throw.

featureCatalogue.name: Ability Score Improvement / Talent
featureCatalogue.description: Progression table entry: Ability Score Improvement / Talent. Full clause mapping requires review; do not infer effects.

featureCatalogue.name: Rune Ward
featureCatalogue.description:
When you or an ally within 30 ft takes damage, use your 
reaction to reduce the damage by 1d8 + your
psychic ability modifier. This increases Warp Pressure by 
1.

featureCatalogue.name: Farseer's Echo
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, whenever you cast a 
Warlock, Divination, or Telekinesis power,
choose one ally within 30 ft. That ally may move 5 ft or 
add +1d4 to their next attack roll, saving
throw, or ability check before your next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Warlock Path
featureCatalogue.description:
Path Benefit
Seer of Battle
Once per short rest, add or 
subtract 1d4 from a d20 roll made 
by a creature you can see.
Storm Warlock
When you deal force, lightning, 
fire, or radiant damage with a 
psychic power, add +1 damage 
per die.
Spirit Guardian
Allies within 10 ft of you gain 
advantage on saving throws 
against fear while you are 
conscious.

featureCatalogue.name: Ability Score Improvement / Talent
featureCatalogue.description: Progression table entry: Ability Score Improvement / Talent. Full clause mapping requires review; do not infer effects.

featureCatalogue.name: Empowered Rune
featureCatalogue.description:
At level 5, once per short rest, cast one Warlock, 
Divination, or Telekinesis power as Empowered without
paying the additional Empowered Warp Pressure cost.

featureCatalogue.name: Battle-Seer
featureCatalogue.description:
When you cast a psychic power from Divination, 
Telekinesis, or the Warlock list, you may move 5 ft
before or after the power without provoking opportunity 
attacks.

featureCatalogue.name: Path Feature
featureCatalogue.description:
Warlock Path Feature
Seer of Battle Your d4 becomes a d6 for your 
Warlock Path feature.
Storm Warlock
Once per turn, when a psychic 
power damages a creature, push it 
5 ft.
Warlock Path Feature
Spirit Guardian
When you reduce damage with 
Rune Ward, the target also gains 
temporary HP equal to your 
proficiency bonus.

featureCatalogue.name: Ghosthelm Discipline
featureCatalogue.description:
When Perils trigger, reduce the psychic damage you take 
from the Perils result by your proficiency
bonus. Once per long rest, you may reroll the Perils 
severity roll, but must use the new result.

featureCatalogue.name: Aeldari Warlock training and hit die
featureCatalogue.description:
11.12 Aeldari Warlock
An Aeldari battle-seer, a former Seer who has walked the Path of the Warrior, or rune-armoured psyker
operating under a hidden command. This is not a normal Imperial psyker and should be used carefully.
Allowed Species: Aeldari only.
Hit Die: d6.
Primary Abilities: Wisdom or Intelligence, Dexterity.
Saving Throws: Wisdom, Intelligence.
Armour: Aeldari mesh, rune armour.
Weapons: Aeldari weapons, witchblades, singing spears, pistols.
Special: Uses Runes of Battle and Warp Pressure. Aeldari Warlocks do not learn Malefic powers.

featureCatalogue.name: Authority
featureCatalogue.description:
As an action, command one creature within 30 ft that can 
hear you. It must make a Wisdom saving
throw. DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier. 
On a failure, choose one: the target is frightened
until the end of your next turn; the target drops prone; or 
the target drops one held item. Uses:
proficiency bonus per long rest.

featureCatalogue.name: Enforcer Training
featureCatalogue.description:
Gain proficiency in two skills from Athletics, Insight, 
Intimidation, Investigation, Perception, and
Persuasion.

featureCatalogue.name: Judgement Protocol
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per short rest, when you hit a creature that is 
frightened, prone, restrained, stunned, or
Suppressed, the attack becomes a critical hit.

featureCatalogue.name: Riot Control
featureCatalogue.description:
When you force a creature to make a save against 
Authority, Lockdown Order, or No Escape, you may
also choose one ally within 30 ft. That ally may move 5 ft 
without provoking opportunity attacks.

featureCatalogue.name: Ability Score Improvement / Talent
featureCatalogue.description: Progression table entry: Ability Score Improvement / Talent. Full clause mapping requires review; do not infer effects.

featureCatalogue.name: Legal Terror
featureCatalogue.description:
Creatures that fail a saving throw against your Authority 
are also Suppressed until the start of your next
turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Doctrine Feature
featureCatalogue.description:
Enforcement Doctrine Feature
Riot Shield
While using a shield, you gain 
resistance to damage from 
opportunity attacks.
Executioner
Once per turn, when you reduce a 
hostile creature to 0 hit points, 
another hostile creature within 30 
ft must make a Wisdom save or 
become frightened until your next 
turn.
Investigator
Once per short rest, ask the GM 
one tactical question about a 
creature, device, crime scene, or 
battlefield; the GM answers 
truthfully but briefly.

featureCatalogue.name: Sentence Executed
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per long rest, declare sentence on one creature 
you can see within 60 ft. For 1 minute, your first hit
each turn against that creature deals +1d10 damage. If it 
drops to 0 hit points during this minute, regain
one use of Authority.

featureCatalogue.name: Ability Score Improvement / Talent
featureCatalogue.description: Progression table entry: Ability Score Improvement / Talent. Full clause mapping requires review; do not infer effects.

featureCatalogue.name: Absolute Jurisdiction
featureCatalogue.description:
When a creature fails a save against Authority, 
Lockdown Order, or No Escape, it also has
disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the 
end of its next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Doctrine Feature
featureCatalogue.description:
Enforcement Doctrine Feature
Riot Shield
While using a shield, you and one 
adjacent ally gain +1 to Dexterity 
saves.
Executioner Judgement Protocol deals an extra 
+2d6 damage.
Investigator
When you ask a tactical question, 
you may also learn one useful 
weakness, route, or leverage 
point.

featureCatalogue.name: Ability Score Improvement / Talent
featureCatalogue.description: Progression table entry: Ability Score Improvement / Talent. Full clause mapping requires review; do not infer effects.

featureCatalogue.name: Breach and Clear
featureCatalogue.description:
During the first round of combat, you gain +10 ft 
movement and advantage on your first attack against a
creature that has not acted yet.

featureCatalogue.name: Final Sentence
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per long rest, when you declare Sentence 
Executed, all allies within 30 ft who can hear you gain 
advantage on their first attack against the sentenced 
creature. For the duration of Sentence Executed, the first 
time each round an ally hits that creature, the hit deals 
+1d6 damage. If the creature is reduced to 0 hit points, 
all hostile creatures within 30 ft must make a Wisdom 
save against your Authority DC or become frightened 
until the end of your next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Enforcement Doctrine
featureCatalogue.description:
Doctrine Benefit
Riot Shield
While using a shield, you gain +1 
AC and advantage against being 
shoved.
Executioner
Your attacks against frightened, 
prone, or restrained creatures deal 
+1d6 damage.
Investigator
Gain expertise in Investigation or 
Insight. As a bonus action, study 
one creature, device, or scene you 
can see within 60 ft; until the end 
of your next turn, it counts as 
studied for your Investigator 
features. Uses: proficiency bonus 
per long rest.

featureCatalogue.name: Ability Score Improvement / Talent
featureCatalogue.description: Progression table entry: Ability Score Improvement / Talent. Full clause mapping requires review; do not infer effects.

featureCatalogue.name: Extra Attack
featureCatalogue.description:
At level 5, you can attack twice when you take the Attack 
action. You may replace one of those attacks with 
Authority; doing so still expends a use of Authority as 
normal.

featureCatalogue.name: Lockdown Order
featureCatalogue.description:
As an action, choose a 15-ft area you can see within 60 
ft. Hostile creatures in that area must make a
Wisdom save against your Authority DC. On a failure, 
they cannot take reactions and their speed is
halved until the start of your next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Doctrine Feature
featureCatalogue.description:
Enforcement Doctrine Feature
Riot Shield
When you take the Dodge action 
with a shield, one adjacent ally 
also gains +2 AC.
Executioner Your Executioner damage 
becomes +1d8.
Investigator
When you hit a creature you have 
studied or identified, add your 
Wisdom modifier to the damage 
once per turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Ability Score Improvement / Talent
featureCatalogue.description: Progression table entry: Ability Score Improvement / Talent. Full clause mapping requires review; do not infer effects.

featureCatalogue.name: No Escape
featureCatalogue.description:
When a creature you can see within 30 ft moves away 
from you or an ally, you may use your reaction to
force it to make a Wisdom save. On a failure, its 
movement ends.

featureCatalogue.name: Arbites Enforcer training and hit die
featureCatalogue.description:
11.5 Arbites Enforcer
Judge, riot officer, executioner, investigator, and breacher.
Allowed Species: Human only.
Hit Die: d10.
Primary Abilities: Strength or Dexterity, Wisdom.
Saving Throws: Strength, Wisdom.
Armour: Light, medium, flak, carapace, riot armour.
Weapons: Pistols, shotguns, shock weapons, mauls, shields, grenades.

featureCatalogue.name: Claim Sight
featureCatalogue.description:
As a bonus action, mark one creature, object, route, or 
terrain feature within 120 ft that you can see.
Until the end of your next turn, you or one ally gains +1d4 
to the next check or attack involving that
mark. Uses: proficiency bonus per long rest.

featureCatalogue.name: Prospector Training
featureCatalogue.description:
Gain proficiency in Survival and one of Investigation, 
Perception, Stealth, Technology, or Vehicles. You
also gain proficiency with prospector rigs and Kin ranged 
weapons.

featureCatalogue.name: Perfect Claim
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per short rest, when you use Claim Sight on a 
creature, your next hit against it becomes a critical
hit on a roll of 19-20.

featureCatalogue.name: Deep Scan
featureCatalogue.description:
As an action, study a creature, machine, vehicle, 
structure, or battlefield feature within 120 ft. Learn one
resistance, weakness, hidden danger, structural flaw, 
route, or tactical fact, as appropriate.

featureCatalogue.name: Warp Pressure
featureCatalogue.description:
A Psyker has a score called Warp Pressure.
Warp Pressure starts at 0.
Whenever you use a psychic power, increase your Warp 
Pressure by that power’s cost.
After resolving the power, roll a d20. If the result is equal 
to or lower than your current Warp Pressure,
Perils of the Warp triggers.
Example:
● Your Warp Pressure is 5.
● You cast Focused Rupture.
● Focused Rupture adds +2 Warp Pressure.
● Your Warp Pressure is now 7.
● You roll a d20.
● On a 1- 7, Perils trigger.

increases your Warp Pressure by 1.

featureCatalogue.name: Sanctioned Apex
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per long rest, when you cast a Major Power, you 
may apply two different Empowered
options to it. Increase Warp Pressure only once for 
Empowering, but if Perils triggers, add +2 to
the severity roll.

featureCatalogue.description:
Discipline Feature
Biomancer
When you heal a creature, it gains 
temporary hit points equal to your 
proficiency bonus.
Telekine
When you cast a force power, you 
may push the target 10 ft on a 
failed save.
Diviner
Once per short rest, add or 
subtract 1d4 from a d20 roll made 
by a creature you can see.
Pyromancer Fire powers deal +1 damage per 
damage die.
Malefic-Touched
When you trigger Perils, your next 
psychic power deals +1d8 
damage.
Discipline Feature
Blank / Null-Bound
You have advantage on saving 
throws against psychic powers 
and Perils effects. When a 
creature you can see within 30 ft 
gains Warp Pressure, you may 
use your reaction to reduce 
psychic damage dealt to one ally 
by your proficiency bonus.

featureCatalogue.name: Empowered Manifestation
featureCatalogue.description:
At level 5, once per short rest, you may cast a psychic 
power as Empowered without increasing its warp 
pressure cost.

featureCatalogue.name: Disciplined Channel
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per short rest, after using a power from your 
chosen discipline, reduce the Warp Pressure gained
by that power by 1, minimum 1.

featureCatalogue.name: Discipline Feature
featureCatalogue.description:
Discipline Feature
Biomancer Your healing powers also end one 
minor bleeding or poison effect.
Telekine Your forced movement increases 
by 5 ft.
Diviner
When you use a reaction power, 
you may move 5 ft without 
provoking opportunity attacks.
Pyromancer
Creatures damaged by your 
Pyromancy powers cannot benefit 
from invisibility until your next turn.
Malefic-Touched
When you frighten a creature with 
a Malefic power, you gain 
temporary HP equal to your 
proficiency bonus.
Blank / Null-Bound
When you reduce psychic damage 
or resist a psychic effect, one 
hostile psyker or daemon within 30 
ft has disadvantage on its next 
Wisdom or Charisma saving throw 
before the end of your next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Warp Anchor
featureCatalogue.description:
When Perils triggers, roll twice on the Perils severity roll 
and use the lower result. Once you use this
feature, you cannot use it again until a long rest.

featureCatalogue.name: Psyker training and hit die
featureCatalogue.description:
11.3 Psyker
A sanctioned psychic operative walking the knife-edge between weapon and catastrophe.
Allowed Species: Human only.
Hit Die: d6.
Primary Abilities: Intelligence or Wisdom.
Saving Throws: Intelligence, Wisdom.
Armour: Light armour.
Weapons: Simple weapons, pistols, and force weapons.
Special: Uses Psychic Powers and Perils of the Warp.

featureCatalogue.name: Deadeye
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per turn, when you hit with a ranged weapon attack 
and had advantage on the attack roll, you deal
an extra +1d6 damage. This increases to +2d6 at level 5 
and +3d6 at level 11.

featureCatalogue.name: Small Target
featureCatalogue.description:
When you are behind light cover, you treat it as heavy 
cover. When you are prone, ranged attacks
against you suffer an additional -2 penalty.

featureCatalogue.name: Perfect Shot
featureCatalogue.description:
When you use Killshot, add your Wisdom modifier to the 
damage roll, and the target cannot take
reactions until the end of its next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Deadeye +3d6
featureCatalogue.description: Progression table entry: Deadeye +3d6. Full clause mapping requires review; do not infer effects.

featureCatalogue.description: Progression table entry: Ability Score Improvement / Talent. Full clause mapping requires review; do not infer effects.

featureCatalogue.name: Gone Before the Shot
featureCatalogue.description:
After you hit or miss with a ranged attack from cover, you 
may move 5 ft without provoking opportunity
attacks.

featureCatalogue.name: Ratling Trick Feature
featureCatalogue.description:
Ratling Trick Feature
Long-Las Sniper
When you use Killshot, the attack 
ignores light and heavy cover and 
ignores resistance from non-
powered armour.
Ratling Trick Feature
Underhive Rat
Once per short rest, when an 
attack misses you while you are in 
cover, you may Hide as a reaction.
Spotter
Your marked target grants +1d4 to 
the next two allied attacks instead 
of one.
Black-Market Gremlin
When you spend downtime in a 
settlement, reduce the cost or 
difficulty of acquiring illegal 
ammunition or forged papers.

featureCatalogue.name: Ghost Marksman
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, you remain hidden after 
making a ranged attack if you are in heavy
cover or heavily obscured. The attack still reveals the 
direction of the shot, but not your exact position.

featureCatalogue.description:
You may Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action. 
Moving through the space of a Medium or larger
ally does not count as difficult terrain for you.

featureCatalogue.name: Impossible Little Legend
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, you cannot be targeted 
by opportunity attacks, and the first
ranged attack you make each turn from cover has 
advantage. If that attack hits, you may
immediately Hide without using an action.

featureCatalogue.name: Ratling Trick
featureCatalogue.description:

first ranged attack gains +2 to hit.
Underhive Rat

of Hand. You have advantage on 
checks to hide in urban ruins, 
crowds, vents, pipes, and debris.
Spotter

enemy you can see within 120 ft. 
The next ally to attack that target 
gains +1d4 to hit. This benefit 
affects allies only and does not 
apply to your own attack unless a 
later feature says otherwise.
Black-Market Gremlin
You can usually acquire illegal 
ammo, fake papers, ration packs,

with thieves’ tools.

featureCatalogue.description:
At level 5, once per short rest, when you hit a creature 
with a ranged weapon attack using an Accurate
weapon, you may turn the hit into a critical hit. Your 
Deadeye damage also increases to +2d6.

featureCatalogue.name: Cameleoline Habits
featureCatalogue.description:
If you have cover or concealment, you may attempt to 
hide even when lightly observed, provided you do
not move more than half your speed this turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Ratling Trick Feature
featureCatalogue.description:

Long-Las Sniper Your first Accurate weapon hit 
each combat adds +1d6 damage.
Underhive Rat
Climbing, crawling, squeezing, and 
moving through tight spaces costs 
you no extra movement.
Spotter Your mark also adds +1 damage.
Black-Market Gremlin
Once per session, produce one 
plausible piece of minor 
contraband or ammunition.

featureCatalogue.name: Impossible Angle
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per short rest, ignore light and heavy cover on one 
ranged weapon attack.

featureCatalogue.name: Ratling Sharpshooter training and hit die
featureCatalogue.description:
11.7 Ratling Sharpshooter
A tiny marksman, scout, thief, spotter, and survivor who wins fights through positioning and precision.
Allowed Species: Ratling only.
Hit Die: d8.
Primary Abilities: Dexterity, Wisdom.
Saving Throws: Dexterity, Wisdom.
Armour: Light armour, flak armour.
Weapons: Pistols, knives, shotguns, lasguns, long-las, sniper weapons.
Tools: Cook’s utensils or thieves’ tools.

featureCatalogue.name: Machine Focus
featureCatalogue.description:
You do not suffer disadvantage on Perception checks in 
darkness if you have an auspex, visor, or
integrated optics. You gain proficiency in Investigation or 
Technology.

featureCatalogue.name: Targeting Protocol
featureCatalogue.description:
As a bonus action, mark one enemy within 90 ft. Until the 
end of your turn, your next weapon attack
against it gains +1d4 to hit. Uses: proficiency bonus 
per long rest.

featureCatalogue.name: Omnissian Execution
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per short rest, when Targeting Protocol causes an 
attack to hit, add 2d8 damage. If the target is a
daemon, heretek, machine, vehicle, or heavily 
augmented creature, add 3d8 instead.

featureCatalogue.name: Calculated Volley
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per turn, when you hit a target marked by Targeting 
Protocol, you may immediately mark a
second creature within 30 ft of the original target. This 
second mark lasts until the end of your next
turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Ability Score Improvement / Talent
featureCatalogue.description: Progression table entry: Ability Score Improvement / Talent. Full clause mapping requires review; do not infer effects.

featureCatalogue.name: Redundant Systems
featureCatalogue.description:
When you fail a Constitution, Dexterity, or Intelligence 
saving throw, you may add 1d4 to the result. You
can use this after seeing the roll but before the GM 
declares the result. Uses: proficiency bonus per long
rest.

featureCatalogue.name: Protocol Feature
featureCatalogue.description:
Combat Protocol Feature
Ranger
Your first ranged hit each combat 
deals +2d6 damage if you did not 
move.
Vanguard
Creatures damaged by your rad or 
poison effects cannot regain hit 
points until your next turn.
Protector
When you use your reaction to 
protect an ally, reduce damage by 
your Intelligence modifier if the 
attack still hits.
Data-Hunter
Your identified target loses one 
resistance of the GM’s choice 
against the next damage it takes.
Infiltrator
When hidden from auspex or 
standard vision, your next hit deals 
+1d8 damage.
Combat Protocol Feature
Ruststalker
Your melee critical hits disable 
reactions until the target’s next 
turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Will of the Omnissiah
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per long rest, enter a perfect doctrinal state for 1 
minute. During this time, Targeting Protocol does
not expend uses, but you may only have one target 
marked at a time.

featureCatalogue.name: Perfect Targeting Logic
featureCatalogue.description:
When you roll initiative, you may immediately use 
Targeting Protocol without expending a use.
If you hit that target before the end of your first turn, add 
your Intelligence modifier to the
damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Protocol Feature
featureCatalogue.description:

Ranger
Your accurate weapons also 
ignore heavy cover once per 
round.

Strength or Constitution save.

target two allies within 30 ft.
Data-Hunter
Your identified target grants +1 to 
allied attack rolls until your next 
turn.
Infiltrator You may remain hidden after a 
miss.

targets deal +1d8 damage.

featureCatalogue.description:

Protocols instead of one. You gain both
benefits, and your Doctrinal Subroutine choice applies at 
the start of each of your turns.

featureCatalogue.description:

damage.

Constitution saving throw before

targeted by an attack, you may 
use your reaction before the roll is 
resolved to give that ally +2 AC

Technology. Once per short rest, 
identify one weakness, resistance, 
or tactical feature of an enemy you 
can observe.

per short rest, as a bonus action, 
become hidden from creatures 
relying on standard vision or 
auspex until the end of your turn, 
provided you have cover or 
concealment.

melee attacks deal +1d6 damage 
against targets below half their hit 
points.

featureCatalogue.description:
At level 5, you can attack twice when you take the Attack 
action.

featureCatalogue.description:
At the start of combat, choose Accuracy, Endurance, or 
Pursuit. Accuracy: +1 to your first attack roll.
Endurance: temporary HP equal to your proficiency 
bonus. Pursuit: +10 ft speed on your first turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Protocol Feature
featureCatalogue.description:

Ranger Your Ranger Protocol damage 
becomes +1d6.
Vanguard
A creature affected by Vanguard 
Protocol also takes +1d4 rad or 
poison damage when you hit it.
Protector
If the protected attack misses, the 
ally gains temporary HP equal to 
your Intelligence modifier.

The next ally to damage the 
identified enemy adds +1d6 
damage.
Infiltrator
You may move 10 ft as part of the 
bonus action used to activate 
Infiltrator Protocol.
Ruststalker
Your melee attacks ignore 
resistance from non-powered 
armour.

featureCatalogue.name: Blessed Autosenses
featureCatalogue.description:
You cannot suffer disadvantage on Perception checks 
caused by darkness, smoke, fog, or visual
interference while your optics, auspex, or visor are 
functional.

featureCatalogue.name: Skitarii Veteran training and hit die
featureCatalogue.description:
11.8 Skitarii Veteran
A machine-disciplined marksman, cybernetic hunter, rad-soldier, or Mechanicus shock trooper.
Allowed Species: Skitarii only.
Hit Die: d10.
Primary Abilities: Dexterity, Intelligence.
Saving Throws: Dexterity, Intelligence.
Armour: Light, medium, flak, carapace.
Weapons: Pistols, basic firearms, advanced firearms, shock weapons, rad weapons, Mechanicus
weapons, grenades.

featureCatalogue.name: Guardsman Training
featureCatalogue.description:
Gain proficiency in two skills from Athletics, Insight, 
Intimidation, Medicine, Perception, Stealth, and Survival. 
You also gain proficiency with one specialist weapon 
group: sniper weapons, plasma weapons, melta 
weapons, or heavy weapons.

featureCatalogue.name: Tactical Aim
featureCatalogue.description:
As a bonus action, choose one creature you can see 
within weapon range. Until the end of your turn,
your next ranged weapon attack against that creature 
deals bonus damage equal to your proficiency
bonus.

featureCatalogue.name: Killing Zone
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per short rest, choose a 20-ft area you can see. 
Until the start of your next turn, the first time each
hostile creature enters that area or leaves cover inside it, 
you may make one ranged weapon attack
against it as a reaction. You still only have one reaction.

featureCatalogue.name: Veteran’s Accuracy
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per turn, when you hit with a ranged weapon 
attack, add +1d6 damage if you had cover, did not
move, or were benefiting from an ally’s mark or order.

featureCatalogue.name: Ability Score Improvement / Talent
featureCatalogue.description: Progression table entry: Ability Score Improvement / Talent. Full clause mapping requires review; do not infer effects.

featureCatalogue.name: Battlefield Instinct
featureCatalogue.description:
You cannot be surprised while conscious. When initiative 
is rolled, you may move up to 10 ft before the
first turn begins, provided this movement ends in cover or 
closer to an ally.

featureCatalogue.name: Improved Doctrine
featureCatalogue.description:
Doctrine Improved Feature
Shock Trooper Your Shock Trooper bonus 
becomes +1d8.
Marksman Your first ranged attack each turn 
ignores light cover.
Sergeant
Allies benefiting from your 
Sergeant doctrine add +1d4 to 
their first failed fear or 
Suppression save each combat.

featureCatalogue.name: Kill Confirmed
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per short rest, when you hit a creature with a 
ranged weapon attack, turn the hit into a critical hit. If the 
target is already bloodied, Suppressed, prone, or 
exposed out of cover, add an extra 2d6 damage after 
resolving the critical hit.

featureCatalogue.name: Ability Score Improvement / Talent
featureCatalogue.description: Progression table entry: Ability Score Improvement / Talent. Full clause mapping requires review; do not infer effects.

featureCatalogue.name: Veteran's Command
featureCatalogue.description:
When you use Tactical Aim, choose one ally within 30 ft 
who can see or hear you. That ally may
add your proficiency bonus to their next weapon damage 
roll against the same target before the
start of your next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Dug-In Kill Team
featureCatalogue.description:
While you are in cover, allies within 10 ft of you gain +1 
AC against ranged attacks and +1 to
saving throws against Suppression. This bonus ends for 
an ally if they move more than half
their speed away from cover.

featureCatalogue.name: Ability Score Improvement / Talent
featureCatalogue.description: Progression table entry: Ability Score Improvement / Talent. Full clause mapping requires review; do not infer effects.

featureCatalogue.name: Suppressing Fire
featureCatalogue.description:
When using a weapon with Burst or Suppression, you 
may force one target you attacked this turn to
make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it becomes 
Suppressed.

featureCatalogue.name: Lord Castellan's Moment
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, you may use Tactical 
Aim at the start of each of your turns without spending a 
bonus action. Once per round when you hit the aimed 
target, choose one ally within 30 ft who can see or hear 
you. That ally may reload one weapon without using an 
action, move 10 ft without provoking opportunity attacks, 
or add +1d6 damage to its next hit against that target 
before your next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Regimental Doctrine
featureCatalogue.description:
Doctrine Benefit
Shock Trooper
Once per turn, when you hit with a 
lasgun, autogun, shotgun, or 
bolter, deal +1d6 damage.
Marksman If you did not move this turn, your 
first ranged attack gains +2 to hit.
Sergeant
Allies within 30 ft who can hear 
you gain +1 to initiative and fear 
saves.

featureCatalogue.name: Fire Team Veteran
featureCatalogue.description:
When you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack, 
one ally within 30 ft who can see or hear you
gains +1 to their next attack roll against that creature 
before the start of your next turn. Uses:
proficiency bonus per long rest.

featureCatalogue.name: Doctrine Feature
featureCatalogue.description:
Doctrine Feature
Shock Trooper
Once per short rest, reroll one 
damage die for a lasgun, autogun, 
shotgun, or bolter.
Marksman Accurate weapons gain +1 
damage when you did not move.
Sergeant
When an ally within 30 ft fails a 
fear or Suppression save, use 
your reaction to let them reroll it.

featureCatalogue.name: Hold the Line
featureCatalogue.description:
While you are in cover, allies within 5 ft of you also gain 
advantage on saving throws against
Suppression.

featureCatalogue.name: Veteran training and hit die
featureCatalogue.description:
11.1 Veteran
Professional soldier, marksman, squad leader, or hardened guardsman.
Allowed Species: Human, Ratling.
Hit Die: d10.
Primary Abilities: Dexterity, Wisdom.
Saving Throws: Dexterity, Wisdom.
Armour: Light, medium, flak, carapace.
Weapons: Simple weapons, martial melee weapons, pistols, basic firearms, grenades.

featureCatalogue.name: Fury of Faith
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per turn, when you hit with a melee weapon attack, 
you may deal extra radiant or fire damage
equal to your proficiency bonus.

featureCatalogue.name: Martyr’s Endurance
featureCatalogue.description:
When you are below half your maximum hit points, you 
gain +1 AC and advantage on saving throws
against being frightened.

featureCatalogue.name: Martyr’s Mercy
featureCatalogue.description:
As an action, touch yourself or one willing creature. The 
target regains hit points equal to 1d6 + your
Wisdom or Charisma modifier. Uses: proficiency 
bonus per long rest.

featureCatalogue.name: Sainted Fury
featureCatalogue.description:
As a bonus action once per long rest, enter a sainted fury 
for 1 minute. Your Fury of Faith damage becomes 1d8 + 
your proficiency bonus. During this time, you have 
advantage on saving throws against fear and corruption 
effects.

featureCatalogue.name: Martyr’s Renewal
featureCatalogue.description:
When you use Martyr’s Mercy, roll 2d6 instead of 1d6. If 
the target is below half hit points, add your
proficiency bonus to the healing.

featureCatalogue.name: Ability Score Improvement / Talent
featureCatalogue.description: Progression table entry: Ability Score Improvement / Talent. Full clause mapping requires review; do not infer effects.

featureCatalogue.name: Unbroken Creed
featureCatalogue.description:
You are immune to the frightened condition while below 
half your maximum hit points. Allies within 10
ft of you have advantage on saves against fear while you 
are conscious.

featureCatalogue.name: Sacred Path Feature
featureCatalogue.description:
Sacred Path Feature
Preacher
Once per long rest, as an action, 
up to three allies within 30 ft regain 
hit points equal to 2d6 + your 
Wisdom or Charisma modifier.
Flagellant
Once per turn, when you are 
below half hit points, your melee 
attacks deal +1d8 radiant or fire 
damage.
Purifier
Your fire damage ignores 
resistance, and 
daemons/corrupted creatures 
cannot regain hit points until the 
start of your next turn after taking 
your fire damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Living Saint’s Shadow
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per long rest, when you are reduced to 0 hit points 
but not killed outright, or when you fail a death saving 
throw, you instead stand with 1 hit point, end the prone 
condition on yourself, and emit a 30-ft aura until the end 
of your next turn. Allies in the aura gain advantage on 
attack rolls and saving throws against fear.

featureCatalogue.name: Ability Score Improvement / Talent
featureCatalogue.description: Progression table entry: Ability Score Improvement / Talent. Full clause mapping requires review; do not infer effects.

featureCatalogue.name: Martyrdom Unending
featureCatalogue.description:
When you are below half your maximum hit points, your 
Martyr’s Mercy restores an additional 1d6 hit points. You 
also have advantage on saving throws against psychic 
intimidation and corruption effects; you remain immune to 
the frightened condition while Unbroken Creed applies.

featureCatalogue.name: Sacred Path Ascendant
featureCatalogue.description:

fear saves.
Flagellant
The first time each round you take 
damage, gain temporary HP equal

affected creature cannot benefit 
from cover against your next 
attack before your next turn.

featureCatalogue.description:
As a bonus action, move up to your speed toward a 
hostile creature you can see. If you end this
movement within melee range, your next melee attack 
this turn deals +1d6 damage. Uses: proficiency
bonus per long rest.

featureCatalogue.name: Living Icon of Wrath
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, your Fury of Faith 
applies to every melee hit rather than once
per turn. If you would drop to 0 hit points during this 
minute, you may immediately use
Martyr’s Mercy on yourself before falling unconscious.

That ally regains hit points equal to your proficiency 
bonus. You can trigger this healing once per round.

featureCatalogue.description:

When you use Martyr’s Mercy, the

next saving throw against fear.
Flagellant

temporary HP equal to your

increases by +1 per damage die 
against daemons, heretics, 
mutants, and corrupted creatures.
