featureCatalogue.name: Refuse the Dark
featureCatalogue.description:
Once per long rest, when you or an ally within 30 ft would 
drop to 0 hit points, you may use your
reaction to let the target drop to 1 hit point instead.

featureCatalogue.name: Zealot training and hit die
featureCatalogue.description:
11.2 Zealot
Fanatic, martyr, firebrand, preacher, and close-combat executioner.
Allowed Species: Human.
Hit Die: d10.
Primary Abilities: Strength or Dexterity, Charisma or Wisdom.
Saving Throws: Strength, Charisma.
Armour: Light, medium, flak, carapace.
Weapons: Simple weapons, martial melee weapons, pistols, flamers, and chain weapons.

featureCatalogue.name: Artificer Armour
featureCatalogue.description: Masterwork Trait: Artificer Armour; Eligible Item: Armour; Effect: Increase the armour's AC by +1. A shield or field cannot gain this trait.

featureCatalogue.name: Artificer Edge
featureCatalogue.description: Masterwork Trait: Artificer Edge; Eligible Item: Melee weapon; Effect: Once per turn when you roll weapon damage, reroll one damage die and use the new result.

featureCatalogue.name: Compact Pattern
featureCatalogue.description: Masterwork Trait: Compact Pattern; Eligible Item: Pistol, basic firearm or compact melee weapon; Effect: Advantage on checks to conceal the item; it can be readied from concealment without an item interaction once per turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Perfect Balance
featureCatalogue.description: Masterwork Trait: Perfect Balance; Eligible Item: Melee or ranged weapon; Effect: Gain +1 to attack rolls made with the item.

featureCatalogue.name: Precision Barrel / Focusing Array
featureCatalogue.description: Masterwork Trait: Precision Barrel / Focusing Array; Eligible Item: Ranged weapon; Effect: Increase normal range by 25%. This does not increase maximum range beyond double the new normal range.

featureCatalogue.name: Rapid Feed
featureCatalogue.description: Masterwork Trait: Rapid Feed; Eligible Item: Reload weapon; Effect: Increase Reload by 50%, rounded up. Does not stack with Extended Magazine.

featureCatalogue.name: Recoil Compensation
featureCatalogue.description: Masterwork Trait: Recoil Compensation; Eligible Item: Heavy ranged weapon; Effect: Moving before firing no longer imposes a penalty from the Heavy property, though other Heavy restrictions still apply.

featureCatalogue.name: Responsive Plating
featureCatalogue.description: Masterwork Trait: Responsive Plating; Eligible Item: Armour; Effect: Once per short rest, reduce damage from one non-critical weapon hit by your proficiency bonus.

featureCatalogue.name: Sealed Systems
featureCatalogue.description: Masterwork Trait: Sealed Systems; Eligible Item: Armour; Effect: Gain advantage on saves against gas, smoke and airborne toxins. If the armour is already sealed, it also tolerates brief vacuum exposure without a separate suit breach test.

featureCatalogue.name: Craftworld / Outcast benefits
featureCatalogue.description:
4.9 Craftworld / Outcast
Raised among Aeldari ways, then sent away, exiled, self-
exiled, ranger-bound, corsair-adjacent, or
drawn into a dangerous path beyond normal craftworld 
protection.
Allowed Species: Aeldari.
Skill Proficiency: Choose two from Acrobatics, Insight, 
Perception, Stealth, Survival, and Technology.
Path Discipline: Once per long rest, when you fail a 
Wisdom or Intelligence saving throw, you may
reroll it. You must use the new result.
Alien Poise: You have advantage on checks to move 
silently through ruins, forests, webway structures,
wraithbone architecture, or abandoned alien sites.

featureCatalogue.name: Forge World benefits
featureCatalogue.description:
4.5 Forge World
Raised among manufactorums, machine temples, data-
vaults, and sacred industry.
Allowed Species: Human, Skitarii.
Skill Proficiency: Investigation and Technology.
Machine Rites: You can perform basic maintenance on 
weapons, armour, augmetics, cogitators, and
power systems.
Logic Before Fear: Once per long rest, you may gain 
advantage on a saving throw against fear, panic, or
psychic manipulation.

featureCatalogue.name: Hiveborn benefits
featureCatalogue.description:
4.1 Hiveborn
Raised in the brutal density of a hive city.
Allowed Species: Human, Ratling, rare Ogryn.
Skill Proficiency: Choose one from Deception, Insight, 
Intimidation, Sleight of Hand, or Stealth.
Crowd Rat: You ignore difficult terrain caused by 
crowds, rubble, cramped spaces, pipes, gantries, and
dense urban clutter.
Seen Worse: You have advantage on saving throws 
against fear caused by gore, violence, intimidation,
or battlefield horror.

featureCatalogue.name: Militarum Regiment benefits
featureCatalogue.description:
4.7 Militarum Regiment
Formerly attached to an Imperial Guard force, auxiliary 
formation, or battlefield logistics unit.
Allowed Species: Human, Ogryn, Ratling, limited 
Skitarii.
Skill Proficiency: Choose one from Athletics or Survival, 
and gain Perception.
Squad Drill: Before initiative is rolled, choose one ally 
within 5 ft of you who can see or hear you. You
and that chosen ally each gain +1 to initiative for that 
combat. You must choose the ally before anyone
rolls initiative. If no ally is within 5 ft when initiative is 
called, this feature provides no benefit.
Field Discipline: Once per short rest, you may reroll a 
failed saving throw against Suppression.

featureCatalogue.name: Mining Hold / Guild benefits
featureCatalogue.description:
4.10 Mining Hold / Guild
Raised in a Squat/Kin hold, mining fleet, oath-band, 
salvage guild, prospecting clan, or void-industrial
enclave.
Allowed Species: Squat/Kin.
Skill Proficiency: Choose two from Athletics, 
Investigation, Survival, Technology, and Persuasion.
Oath and Ledger: You can usually identify the likely 
value, industrial purpose, or salvage use of
machinery, ore, weapons, armour, and voidship 
components.
Hold-Fast: Once per short rest, when you fail a saving 
throw against being frightened, knocked prone,
moved, or suppressed, you may reroll it. You must use 
the new result.

featureCatalogue.name: Penal Worlder benefits
featureCatalogue.description:
4.3 Penal Worlder
A convict, survivor, conscript, or former prisoner.
Allowed Species: Human, Ogryn, Ratling.
Skill Proficiency: Survival and one of Athletics, 
Deception, or Intimidation.
Hard Time: You have advantage on saving throws 
against exhaustion caused by forced marches,
starvation, poor conditions, or sleep deprivation.
Dirty Survival: Once per long rest, when you are 
reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you
may drop to 1 hit point instead.

featureCatalogue.name: Schola Progenium benefits
featureCatalogue.description:
4.6 Schola Progenium
Raised in harsh Imperial institutions to become a soldier, 
judge, officer, priest, or specialist.
Allowed Species: Human.
Skill Proficiency: Choose one from History or Religion, 
and one from Intimidation or Persuasion.
Drilled Obedience: You have advantage on saving 
throws against fear while following a direct order,
holding formation, or protecting an Imperial objective.
Imperial Education: You can identify major Imperial 
organisations, ranks, symbols, rites, and
procedures.

featureCatalogue.name: Shrine Worlder benefits
featureCatalogue.description:
4.2 Shrine Worlder
Raised in devotion, ritual, sacrifice, and Imperial worship.
Allowed Species: Human, rare Ratling.
Skill Proficiency: Religion and either Persuasion or 
Intimidation.
Litany of Resolve: Once per long rest, you can give 
yourself or one ally within 30 ft. advantage on a Wisdom 
saving throw.
Sacred Hatred: Once per turn, when you damage a 
heretic, daemon, mutant, witch, traitor, or xenos with
a weapon attack or class feature, you deal an additional 
1d4 + 1 radiant damage.
This damage represents zeal, ritual fury, and trained 
hatred rather than true divine magic.

featureCatalogue.name: Underhive benefits
featureCatalogue.description:
4.8 Underhive
Raised below the proper world, among gangs, sump-rats, 
chem dens, scavvers, and forgotten habs.
Allowed Species: Human, Ratling.
Skill Proficiency: Choose two from Deception, 
Intimidation, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, and Survival.
Black-Market Instinct: You know how to locate illegal 
goods, smugglers, fences, and information
brokers in hive settlements.
Never Fight Fair: Once per short rest, when you hit a 
creature that has not acted yet in combat, deal
additional damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

featureCatalogue.name: Voidborn benefits
featureCatalogue.description:
4.4 Voidborn
Born aboard a voidship, orbital station, warship, pilgrim 
vessel, or ancient wreck.
Allowed Species: Human, Ratling, rare Ogryn.
Skill Proficiency: Choose one from Acrobatics, 
Perception, Investigation, or Technology.
Void Legs: You have advantage on checks and saving 
throws to avoid being knocked prone or moved
against your will.
Shipwise: You are proficient with basic voidship 
procedures, airlocks, auspex consoles, pressure doors,
and shipboard emergency systems.

featureCatalogue.name: Aeldari / Eldar fixed baseline
featureCatalogue.description: Fixed ability adjustments and speed from species entry.

featureCatalogue.name: Aeldari / Eldar traits
featureCatalogue.description:
3.6 Aeldari / Eldar
Aeldari are ancient xenos whose reflexes, senses, and 
psychic presence far exceed human norms. Player
Aeldari should represent rare outcasts, rangers, corsair-
adjacent wanderers, or warlocks operating
under a specific hidden purpose.
Ability Scores: +2 Dexterity, +1 Intelligence or Wisdom.
Size: Medium.
Speed: 35 ft.
Available Classes: Aeldari Outcast, Aeldari Warlock.
3.6.1 Aeldari Traits
Darkvision: You have darkvision to a range of 90 ft (see 
the rules at the start of this chapter).
Inhuman Grace: Gain proficiency in Acrobatics or 
Stealth.
Keen Senses: Gain proficiency in Perception. If you 
already have Perception proficiency, add +1 to
Perception checks instead.
Battle Trance: You may move through the space of 
allied creatures without treating it as difficult
terrain. Once per short rest, when you move at least 10 ft 
before making a weapon attack, add +1d4 to
the attack roll.
Ancient Mind: You have advantage on saving throws 
against being charmed or frightened by non-psychic 
effects.
Xenos Distrust: You have disadvantage on Persuasion 
checks with most Imperial authorities unless
disguised, vouched for, or operating under an established 
truce.

featureCatalogue.name: Human fixed baseline
featureCatalogue.description: Fixed ability adjustments and speed from species entry.

featureCatalogue.name: Human traits
featureCatalogue.description:
3.1 Human
Humans are the baseline of the Imperium: adaptable, 
ambitious, fragile, and dangerously determined.
Ability Scores: +2 to one ability score and +1 to 
another.
Size: Medium.
Speed: 30 ft.
Available Classes: Veteran, Zealot, Psyker, Arbites 
Enforcer, Hive Scum.
3.1.1 Human Traits
Imperial Adaptability: Gain proficiency in one skill of 
your choice.
Broad Training: Gain one additional weapon, tool, or 
language proficiency.
Faith, Fear, or Discipline: Once per long rest, when you 
fail a saving throw, you may reroll it. You must
use the new result.

featureCatalogue.name: Squat / Kin fixed baseline
featureCatalogue.description: Fixed ability adjustments and speed from species entry.

featureCatalogue.name: Squat / Kin traits
featureCatalogue.description:
3.5 Squat / Kin
Squats, often known as Kin in modern Imperial records, 
are hardy void-adapted abhumans associated
with holds, guilds, oath-bands, mining fleets, mercenary 
contracts, and ancient grudges. They are
shorter than humans but dense, resilient, technically 
minded, and extremely difficult to intimidate.
Ability Scores: +2 Constitution, +1 Intelligence or 
Wisdom.
Size: Medium, but your height is usually between 4 and 5 
ft.
Speed: 25 ft.
Available Classes: Kin Armsman, Hernkyn Prospector.
3.5.1 Squat / Kin Traits
Darkvision: You have darkvision to a range of 60 ft (see 
the rules at the start of this chapter).
Dense Build: You have advantage on saving throws 
against being shoved, knocked prone, or moved
against your will.
Void-Hardened: You have advantage on saving throws 
against exhaustion caused by poor atmosphere,
bad rations, forced marches, cramped voidship 
conditions, mining hazards, or environmental hardship.
Guild-Craft: Gain proficiency in Technology, 
Investigation, or one artisan/tool proficiency related to
engineering, mining, weapons, armour, or voidcraft.
Grudge Memory: Once per long rest, when a creature 
damages you or an ally within 30 ft, mark that
creature as the subject of a grudge. The first time you hit 
that creature before the end of the encounter,
add your proficiency bonus to the damage.
Stubborn Kin: You have advantage on saving throws 
against being frightened.

featureCatalogue.name: Ogryn Abhuman fixed baseline
featureCatalogue.description: Fixed ability adjustments and speed from species entry.

featureCatalogue.name: Ogryn Abhuman traits
featureCatalogue.description:
3.2 Ogryn Abhuman
Ogryns are massive abhumans used by the Imperium as 
shock troops, bodyguards, line-breakers, and
living siege weapons. They are loyal and terrifyingly 
durable, but they are not subtle and struggle with
equipment designed for normal human frames.
Ability Scores: +2 Strength, +1 Constitution.
Size: Medium, but you count as one size larger for 
carrying, lifting, pushing, dragging, grappling, and
shoving.
Speed: 30 ft.
Available Classes: Ogryn Skullbreaker only.
3.2.1 Ogryn Traits
Massive Build: Your maximum hit points increase by 3 
per character level. You also count as one size
larger for carrying, lifting, pushing, dragging, grappling, 
and shoving.
Thick Skull: You have advantage on saving throws 
against being frightened.
Brute Strength: Your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 + your 
Strength modifier bludgeoning damage.
Too Big for Standard Kit: You cannot use most 
standard armour, delicate weapons, compact firearms,
or subtle tools unless they have been modified for Ogryn 
use.
Simple Solutions: You are not automatically stupid, but 
you struggle with delicate logic, subtle
interfaces, encrypted systems, and advanced technology. 
You have disadvantage on Intelligence checks
involving advanced technology, forbidden lore, cogitators, 
security systems, encrypted data, or complex
machinery unless you are proficient in a relevant skill or 
tool. However, once per short rest, when a
problem could plausibly be solved through brute force, 
intimidation, endurance, or direct action, you
may add your proficiency bonus to the check even if you 
would not normally be proficient.

featureCatalogue.name: Ratling Abhuman fixed baseline
featureCatalogue.description: Fixed ability adjustments and speed from species entry.

featureCatalogue.name: Ratling Abhuman traits
featureCatalogue.description:
3.3 Ratling Abhuman
Ratlings are small abhumans known for stealth, 
marksmanship, scavenging, cooking, black-market
dealings, and improbable survival.
Ability Scores: +2 Dexterity, +1 Wisdom.
Size: Small.
Speed: 25 ft.
Available Classes: Ratling Sharpshooter, Veteran, Hive 
Scum.
3.3.1 Ratling Traits
Darkvision: You have darkvision to a range of 60 ft (see 
the rules at the start of this chapter).
Small Target: When you have light cover, you may treat 
it as heavy cover.
Sniper’s Eye: You ignore disadvantage from attacking at 
long range with weapons that have the
Accurate property.
Naturally Sneaky: You gain proficiency in Stealth.
Lucky Shot: Once per short rest, when you miss with a 
ranged weapon attack, you may reroll the
attack.
Bad in a Straight Fight: You have disadvantage on 
Strength checks made to shove or grapple creatures
larger than you.

featureCatalogue.name: Skitarii Augmented Human fixed baseline
featureCatalogue.description: Fixed ability adjustments and speed from species entry.

featureCatalogue.name: Skitarii Augmented Human traits
featureCatalogue.description:
3.4 Skitarii Augmented Human
Skitarii are cybernetically enhanced soldiers of the 
Adeptus Mechanicus. They are machine-disciplined,
sensor-linked, and doctrinally conditioned beyond normal 
human limits.
Ability Scores: +2 Dexterity or Intelligence, +1 
Constitution.
Size: Medium.
Speed: 30 ft.
Available Classes: Skitarii Veteran.
3.4.1 Skitarii Traits
Augmetic Body: You have resistance to poison damage 
and advantage on saving throws against
disease.
Machine Discipline: You have advantage on saving 
throws against being charmed.
Noospheric Focus: Gain proficiency in Investigation, 
Perception, or Technology.
Integrated Auspex: Once per short rest, as a bonus 
action, choose one creature within 60 ft that you
can see. Your next attack against that creature before 
the end of your turn gains +1d4 to hit.
Cybernetic Maintenance: During a short rest, if you or 
an ally has tinker’s tools or Mechanicus tools,
you may regain additional hit points equal to your 
proficiency bonus.
No Psychic Potential: You cannot choose the Psyker 
class or any trait that grants psychic powers.

featureCatalogue.name: Corsair level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Corsair; After scoring a critical hit, you may make one pistol or blade attack as a bonus action.

featureCatalogue.name: Corsair level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Corsair; After you move 5 ft from your Corsair feature, your next attack before your next turn gains +1d6 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Corsair level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Corsair; You gain proficiency with pistols and blades. After making a weapon attack, move 5 ft without provoking opportunity attacks.

featureCatalogue.name: Corsair level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Corsair; Your Shuriken Grace damage applies to pistol attacks.

featureCatalogue.name: Ranger level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Ranger; Your Death from Elsewhere feature recharges when you roll initiative if you have no uses remaining.

featureCatalogue.name: Ranger level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Ranger; Your attacks from hiding score a critical hit on 19-20.

featureCatalogue.name: Ranger level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Ranger; If you do not move before attacking with a ranger long rifle, your first ranged attack this turn gains +2 to hit.

featureCatalogue.name: Ranger level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Ranger; Your attacks with Accurate Aeldari weapons ignore light cover.

featureCatalogue.name: Shadow Guide level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Shadow Guide; Once per short rest, you and up to two allies within 30 ft may move 10 ft without provoking opportunity attacks.

featureCatalogue.name: Shadow Guide level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Shadow Guide; Allies moved by your Path Feature may also ignore difficult terrain until your next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Shadow Guide level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Shadow Guide; Gain expertise in Stealth or Survival. You have advantage on checks to navigate ruins, wilderness, alien structures, and webway-adjacent places.

featureCatalogue.name: Shadow Guide level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Shadow Guide; Allies within 10 ft of you ignore non-magical difficult terrain while travelling carefully.

featureCatalogue.name: Seer of Battle level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Seer of Battle; Once per short rest, give one ally advantage on an attack, save, or check as a reaction.

featureCatalogue.name: Seer of Battle level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Seer of Battle; Your reaction advantage may be used after the d20 is rolled but before the result is declared.

featureCatalogue.name: Seer of Battle level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Seer of Battle; Once per short rest, add or subtract 1d4 from a d20 roll made by a creature you can see.

featureCatalogue.name: Seer of Battle level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Seer of Battle; Your d4 becomes a d6 for your Warlock Path feature.

featureCatalogue.name: Spirit Guardian level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Spirit Guardian; Allies protected by your Rune Ward also gain advantage on the next fear or psychic saving throw they make before your next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Spirit Guardian level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Spirit Guardian; When Rune Ward protects an ally, one hostile creature within 30 ft has disadvantage on its next psychic saving throw.

featureCatalogue.name: Spirit Guardian level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Spirit Guardian; Allies within 10 ft of you gain advantage on saving throws against fear while you are conscious.

featureCatalogue.name: Spirit Guardian level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Spirit Guardian; When you reduce damage with Rune Ward, the target also gains temporary HP equal to your proficiency bonus.

featureCatalogue.name: Storm Warlock level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Storm Warlock; Your first damaging psychic power each combat deals +1d8 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Storm Warlock level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Storm Warlock; Your Storm Warlock push increases to 10 ft.

featureCatalogue.name: Storm Warlock level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Storm Warlock; When you deal force, lightning, fire, or radiant damage with a psychic power, add +1 damage per die.

featureCatalogue.name: Storm Warlock level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Storm Warlock; Once per turn, when a psychic power damages a creature, push it 5 ft.

featureCatalogue.name: Executioner level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Executioner; Once per turn, when you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points, another hostile creature within 30 ft must make a Wisdom save or become frightened until your next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Executioner level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Executioner; Judgement Protocol deals an extra +2d6 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Executioner level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Executioner; Your attacks against frightened, prone, or restrained creatures deal +1d6 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Executioner level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Executioner; Your Executioner damage becomes +1d8.

featureCatalogue.name: Investigator level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Investigator; Once per short rest, ask the GM one tactical question about a creature, device, crime scene, or battlefield; the GM answers truthfully but briefly.

featureCatalogue.name: Investigator level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Investigator; When you ask a tactical question, you may also learn one useful weakness, route, or leverage point.

featureCatalogue.name: Investigator level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Investigator; Gain expertise in Investigation or Insight. As a bonus action, study one creature, device, or scene you can see within 60 ft; until the end of your next turn, it counts as studied for your Investigator features. Uses: proficiency bonus per long rest.

featureCatalogue.name: Investigator level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Investigator; When you hit a creature you have studied or identified, add your Wisdom modifier to the damage once per turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Riot Shield level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Riot Shield; While using a shield, you gain resistance to damage from opportunity attacks.

featureCatalogue.name: Riot Shield level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Riot Shield; While using a shield, you and one adjacent ally gain +1 to Dexterity saves.

featureCatalogue.name: Riot Shield level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Riot Shield; While using a shield, you gain +1 AC and advantage against being shoved.

featureCatalogue.name: Riot Shield level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Riot Shield; When you take the Dodge action with a shield, one adjacent ally also gains +2 AC.

featureCatalogue.name: Claim-Staker level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Claim-Staker; Allies within 30 ft add +1 to checks involving your Claim Sight target.

featureCatalogue.name: Claim-Staker level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Claim-Staker; Deep Scan reveals two useful facts instead of one.

featureCatalogue.name: Claim-Staker level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Claim-Staker; You gain expertise in Investigation or Survival. You can identify valuable materials, salvage, ore, or structural weaknesses.

featureCatalogue.name: Claim-Staker level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Claim-Staker; Your Claim Sight die becomes +1d6 for ability checks.

featureCatalogue.name: Outrider level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Outrider; Once per short rest, take the Dash or Disengage action as a free action on your turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Outrider level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Outrider; After you use Outrider’s Escape, your next attack before your next turn has advantage.

featureCatalogue.name: Outrider level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Outrider; Your speed increases by 5 ft. When you Dash, opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage.

featureCatalogue.name: Outrider level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Outrider; When you move at least 15 ft, your next attack this turn deals +1d6 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Trail Gunner level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Trail Gunner; When you score a critical hit with a ranged attack, the target is Suppressed until your next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Trail Gunner level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Trail Gunner; Your Trail Gunner damage becomes +1d8, and that hit ignores light cover.

featureCatalogue.name: Trail Gunner level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Trail Gunner; Your first ranged hit on each of your turns deals +1d4 damage while no hostile creature is adjacent to you.

featureCatalogue.name: Trail Gunner level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Trail Gunner; Your Trail Gunner damage becomes +1d6.

featureCatalogue.name: Chem-User level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Chem-User; Once per long rest, ignore the exhaustion risk from your combat chems.

featureCatalogue.name: Chem-User level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Chem-User; Once per long rest, inject combat chems as a bonus action. Gain +10 ft speed and advantage on Strength and Dexterity checks for 1 minute. Afterwards, make a Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion.

featureCatalogue.name: Chem-User level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Chem-User; You gain advantage on saving throws against poison and combat drugs.

featureCatalogue.name: Gunslinger level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Gunslinger; Your first pistol hit each turn deals +1d6 damage if the target is within 30 ft.

featureCatalogue.name: Gunslinger level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Gunslinger; Once per turn, you can reload a pistol without using an action.

featureCatalogue.name: Gunslinger level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Gunslinger; Once per short rest, make one pistol attack as a bonus action after taking the Attack action.

featureCatalogue.name: Knife Rat level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Knife Rat; When you score a critical hit with a light melee weapon, the target cannot take reactions until its next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Knife Rat level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Knife Rat; Your melee attacks with light weapons score a critical hit on 19- 20.

featureCatalogue.name: Knife Rat level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Knife Rat; Your light melee attacks deal +1 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Sump Ghost level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Sump Ghost; Once per short rest, become hidden from one creature even if it can see you, provided there is cover, smoke, steam, machinery, darkness, or a crowd within 10 ft.

featureCatalogue.name: Sump Ghost level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Sump Ghost; You gain expertise in Stealth when in urban ruins, sewers, vents, tunnels, or industrial terrain.

featureCatalogue.name: Sump Ghost level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Sump Ghost; You may hide when lightly obscured by smoke, steam, crowds, or machinery.

featureCatalogue.name: Guild-Militant level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Guild-Militant; When you mark a target with Oath-Mark, allies gain +1 to damage against it until your next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Guild-Militant level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Guild-Militant; When an ally hits your Oath-Mark target, they may move 5 ft without provoking opportunity attacks.

featureCatalogue.name: Guild-Militant level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Guild-Militant; When you hit a creature marked by Oath-Mark, one ally within 30 ft gains +1 to hit that creature before your next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Guild-Militant level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Guild-Militant; When an ally hits your Oath-Mark target, you may use your reaction to let that ally add +1d6 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Hearthguard level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Hearthguard; While you are below half hit points, your armour damage reduction increases by 1.

featureCatalogue.name: Hearthguard level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Hearthguard; Your armour damage reduction applies to critical hits, but only for 1 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Hearthguard level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Hearthguard; While wearing medium or heavy Kin armour, reduce non-critical weapon damage by 1.

featureCatalogue.name: Hearthguard level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Hearthguard; Your damage reduction becomes 2.

featureCatalogue.name: Ironhead level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Ironhead; Once per short rest, when you damage an object, vehicle, or machine, treat the hit as a critical hit.

featureCatalogue.name: Ironhead level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Ironhead; Your attacks against machines, vehicles, and structures ignore resistance once per turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Ironhead level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Ironhead; You gain advantage on checks to mine, breach, salvage, demolish, or repair machinery and structures.

featureCatalogue.name: Ironhead level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Ironhead; Your attacks against objects, vehicles, and machines deal +1d8 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Bone ’ead level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Bone ’ead; Once per long rest, treat a failed Wisdom or Intelligence saving throw as a success.

featureCatalogue.name: Bone ’ead level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Bone ’ead; Allies within 10 ft gain +1 to Wisdom saves while you are conscious.

featureCatalogue.name: Bone ’ead level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Bone ’ead; You gain proficiency in Wisdom saves and one additional skill.

featureCatalogue.name: Bone ’ead level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Bone ’ead; Once per short rest, when you or an ally within 10 ft fails a Wisdom or Intelligence saving throw against fear, psychic manipulation, confusion, or Suppression, you may use your reaction to let that creature reroll the save.

featureCatalogue.name: Brute level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Brute; Once per turn, when you push or knock a creature prone, deal bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier.

featureCatalogue.name: Brute level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Brute; Your melee critical hits knock targets prone if they fail a Strength save.

featureCatalogue.name: Brute level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Brute; Once per turn, when you hit with a melee weapon, deal +1d6 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Brute level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Brute; Your Brute damage becomes +1d8.

featureCatalogue.name: Bulwark level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Bulwark; Allies benefiting from cover provided by your slab shield have advantage on Dexterity saving throws against Blast and Spray effects, and ignore the first 5 ft of forced movement they would suffer each round.

featureCatalogue.name: Bulwark level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Bulwark; While using a slab shield, adjacent allies also gain resistance to damage from opportunity attacks.

featureCatalogue.name: Bulwark level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Bulwark; While using a shield, allies behind you gain light cover.

featureCatalogue.name: Bulwark level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Bulwark; While using a shield, you also gain advantage on saves against being shoved.

featureCatalogue.name: Gun Lugger level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Gun Lugger; You ignore disadvantage from firing Heavy or Ogryn weapons after moving.

featureCatalogue.name: Gun Lugger level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Gun Lugger; Once per turn, your heavy ranged weapon hit deals +1d8 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Gun Lugger level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Gun Lugger; You can use heavy weapons without the normal movement penalty.

featureCatalogue.name: Gun Lugger level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Gun Lugger; Your first ranged Ogryn weapon attack each turn deals +1d6 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Biomancer level 1
featureCatalogue.description: Biomancer; Universal, Biomancy; Healing, endurance, flesh control, toxins, and forced growth.

featureCatalogue.name: Biomancer level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Biomancer; Once per long rest, when a creature you can touch drops to 0 hit points, it drops to 1 hit point instead.

featureCatalogue.name: Biomancer level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Biomancer; When you heal a creature, it gains temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

featureCatalogue.name: Biomancer level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Biomancer; Your healing powers also end one minor bleeding or poison effect.

featureCatalogue.name: Blank / Null-Bound level 1
featureCatalogue.description: Blank / Null- Bound; Universal, Null; Anti-psychic pressure, witch- hunting, null aura, Warp denial. This rare path should require GM approval because true blanks are not normal psykers.

featureCatalogue.name: Blank / Null-Bound level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Blank / Null- Bound; Once per long rest, when a creature within 60 ft triggers Perils, you may force it to reroll the Perils severity roll and use the lower result if it is an ally, or the higher result if it is hostile.

featureCatalogue.name: Blank / Null-Bound level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Blank / Null-Bound; You have advantage on saving throws against psychic powers and Perils effects. When a creature you can see within 30 ft gains Warp Pressure, you may use your reaction to reduce psychic damage dealt to one ally by your proficiency bonus.

featureCatalogue.name: Blank / Null-Bound level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Blank / Null-Bound; When you reduce psychic damage or resist a psychic effect, one hostile psyker or daemon within 30 ft has disadvantage on its next Wisdom or Charisma saving throw before the end of your next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Diviner level 1
featureCatalogue.description: Diviner; Universal, Divination; Foresight, danger sense, accuracy, fate manipulation, and reading echoes.

featureCatalogue.name: Diviner level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Diviner; Once per long rest, replace a d20 roll made by a creature you can see with a 10 before modifiers.

featureCatalogue.name: Diviner level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Diviner; Once per short rest, add or subtract 1d4 from a d20 roll made by a creature you can see.

featureCatalogue.name: Diviner level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Diviner; When you use a reaction power, you may move 5 ft without provoking opportunity attacks.

featureCatalogue.name: Malefic-Touched level 1
featureCatalogue.description: Malefic- Touched; Universal, Malefic; High-risk damage, fear, possession pressure, daemonic resonance. Using Malefic powers should attract harsher narrative consequences.

featureCatalogue.name: Malefic-Touched level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Malefic-Touched; Once per long rest, after triggering Perils, you may choose to gain 1 Corruption to treat the Perils result as Warp Static.

featureCatalogue.name: Malefic-Touched level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Malefic-Touched; When you trigger Perils, your next psychic power deals +1d8 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Malefic-Touched level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Malefic-Touched; When you frighten a creature with a Malefic power, you gain temporary HP equal to your proficiency bonus.

featureCatalogue.name: Pyromancer level 1
featureCatalogue.description: Pyromancer; Universal, Pyromancy; Fire, soul-burning, area denial, purging flame.

featureCatalogue.name: Pyromancer level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Pyromancer; Once per short rest, your Pyromancy power ignores fire resistance.

featureCatalogue.name: Pyromancer level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Pyromancer; Fire powers deal +1 damage per damage die.

featureCatalogue.name: Pyromancer level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Pyromancer; Creatures damaged by your Pyromancy powers cannot benefit from invisibility until your next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Telekine level 1
featureCatalogue.description: Telekine; Universal, Telekinesis; Force shields, kinetic movement, crushing pressure, battlefield control.

featureCatalogue.name: Telekine level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Telekine; Once per short rest, when you use Psychic Ward, you may also push the attacker 10 ft.

featureCatalogue.name: Telekine level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Telekine; When you cast a force power, you may push the target 10 ft on a failed save.

featureCatalogue.name: Telekine level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Telekine; Your forced movement increases by 5 ft.

featureCatalogue.name: Black-Market Gremlin level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Black-Market Gremlin; When you spend downtime in a settlement, reduce the cost or difficulty of acquiring illegal ammunition or forged papers.

featureCatalogue.name: Black-Market Gremlin level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Black-Market Gremlin; Once per session, produce one rare ammunition, forged credential, or compact tool with GM approval.

featureCatalogue.name: Black-Market Gremlin level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Black-Market Gremlin; You can usually acquire illegal ammo, fake papers, ration packs, or minor contraband in settlements. You gain proficiency with thieves’ tools.

featureCatalogue.name: Black-Market Gremlin level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Black-Market Gremlin; Once per session, produce one plausible piece of minor contraband or ammunition.

featureCatalogue.name: Long-Las Sniper level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Long-Las Sniper; When you use Killshot, the attack ignores light and heavy cover and ignores resistance from non- powered armour.

featureCatalogue.name: Long-Las Sniper level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Long-Las Sniper; Your first Accurate weapon hit each round ignores heavy cover.

featureCatalogue.name: Long-Las Sniper level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Long-Las Sniper; If you do not move this turn, your first ranged attack gains +2 to hit.

featureCatalogue.name: Long-Las Sniper level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Long-Las Sniper; Your first Accurate weapon hit each combat adds +1d6 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Spotter level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Spotter; Your marked target grants +1d4 to the next two allied attacks instead of one.

featureCatalogue.name: Spotter level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Spotter; Your mark grants +1d4 to the next three allied attacks instead of two.

featureCatalogue.name: Spotter level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Spotter; As a bonus action, mark one enemy you can see within 120 ft. The next ally to attack that target gains +1d4 to hit. This benefit affects allies only and does not apply to your own attack unless a later feature says otherwise.

featureCatalogue.name: Spotter level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Spotter; Your mark also adds +1 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Underhive Rat level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Underhive Rat; Once per short rest, when an attack misses you while you are in cover, you may Hide as a reaction.

featureCatalogue.name: Underhive Rat level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Underhive Rat; When you Hide as a reaction, you may also move 5 ft.

featureCatalogue.name: Underhive Rat level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Underhive Rat; Gain expertise in Stealth or Sleight of Hand. You have advantage on checks to hide in urban ruins, crowds, vents, pipes, and debris.

featureCatalogue.name: Underhive Rat level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Underhive Rat; Climbing, crawling, squeezing, and moving through tight spaces costs you no extra movement.

featureCatalogue.name: Data-Hunter Protocol level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Data-Hunter; Your identified target loses one resistance of the GM’s choice against the next damage it takes.

featureCatalogue.name: Data-Hunter Protocol level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Data-Hunter; Your identified target grants +1 to allied attack rolls until your next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Data-Hunter Protocol level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Data-Hunter Protocol; Gain expertise in Investigation or Technology. Once per short rest, identify one weakness, resistance, or tactical feature of an enemy you can observe.

featureCatalogue.name: Data-Hunter Protocol level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Data-Hunter; The next ally to damage the identified enemy adds +1d6 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Infiltrator Protocol level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Infiltrator; When hidden from auspex or standard vision, your next hit deals +1d8 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Infiltrator Protocol level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Infiltrator; You may remain hidden after a miss.

featureCatalogue.name: Infiltrator Protocol level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Infiltrator Protocol; Gain proficiency in Stealth. Once per short rest, as a bonus action, become hidden from creatures relying on standard vision or auspex until the end of your turn, provided you have cover or concealment.

featureCatalogue.name: Infiltrator Protocol level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Infiltrator; You may move 10 ft as part of the bonus action used to activate Infiltrator Protocol.

featureCatalogue.name: Protector Protocol level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Protector; When you use your reaction to protect an ally, reduce damage by your Intelligence modifier if the attack still hits.

featureCatalogue.name: Protector Protocol level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Protector; Your protection reaction may target two allies within 30 ft.

featureCatalogue.name: Protector Protocol level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Protector Protocol; When an ally within 30 ft is targeted by an attack, you may use your reaction before the roll is resolved to give that ally +2 AC against the attack if you can see the attacker.

featureCatalogue.name: Protector Protocol level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Protector; If the protected attack misses, the ally gains temporary HP equal to your Intelligence modifier.

featureCatalogue.name: Ranger Protocol level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Ranger; Your first ranged hit each combat deals +2d6 damage if you did not move.

featureCatalogue.name: Ranger Protocol level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Ranger; Your accurate weapons also ignore heavy cover once per round.

featureCatalogue.name: Ranger Protocol level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Ranger Protocol; If you do not move, your first ranged attack this turn deals +1d4 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Ranger Protocol level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Ranger; Your Ranger Protocol damage becomes +1d6.

featureCatalogue.name: Ruststalker Protocol level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Ruststalker; Your melee critical hits disable reactions until the target’s next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Ruststalker Protocol level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Ruststalker; Your melee hits against bloodied targets deal +1d8 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Ruststalker Protocol level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Ruststalker Protocol; Gain proficiency with blades. Your melee attacks deal +1d6 damage against targets below half their hit points.

featureCatalogue.name: Ruststalker Protocol level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Ruststalker; Your melee attacks ignore resistance from non-powered armour.

featureCatalogue.name: Vanguard Protocol level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Vanguard; Creatures damaged by your rad or poison effects cannot regain hit points until your next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Vanguard Protocol level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Vanguard; Your rad or poison effects impose disadvantage on the target’s next Strength or Constitution save.

featureCatalogue.name: Vanguard Protocol level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Vanguard Protocol; Once per turn, when you hit a creature within 30 ft, it has disadvantage on its next Constitution saving throw before your next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Vanguard Protocol level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Vanguard; A creature affected by Vanguard Protocol also takes +1d4 rad or poison damage when you hit it.

featureCatalogue.name: Marksman 14
featureCatalogue.description: Your first ranged attack each turn ignores light cover.

featureCatalogue.name: Marksman 3
featureCatalogue.description: If you did not move this turn, your first ranged attack gains +2 to hit.

featureCatalogue.name: Marksman 7
featureCatalogue.description: Accurate weapons gain +1 damage when you did not move.

featureCatalogue.name: Sergeant 14
featureCatalogue.description: Allies benefiting from your Sergeant doctrine add +1d4 to their first failed fear or Suppression save each combat.

featureCatalogue.name: Sergeant 3
featureCatalogue.description: Allies within 30 ft who can hear you gain +1 to initiative and fear saves.

featureCatalogue.name: Sergeant 7
featureCatalogue.description: When an ally within 30 ft fails a fear or Suppression save, use your reaction to let them reroll it.

featureCatalogue.name: Shock Trooper 14
featureCatalogue.description: Your Shock Trooper bonus becomes +1d8.

featureCatalogue.name: Shock Trooper 3
featureCatalogue.description: Once per turn, when you hit with a lasgun, autogun, shotgun, or bolter, deal +1d6 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Shock Trooper 7
featureCatalogue.description: Once per short rest, reroll one damage die for a lasgun, autogun, shotgun, or bolter.

featureCatalogue.name: Flagellant level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Flagellant; Once per turn, when you are below half hit points, your melee attacks deal +1d8 radiant or fire damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Flagellant level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Flagellant; The first time each round you take damage, gain temporary HP equal to twice your proficiency bonus.

featureCatalogue.name: Flagellant level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Flagellant; Once per round, when you take damage, your next melee attack deals +1d6 bonus damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Flagellant level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Flagellant; When you take damage, gain temporary HP equal to your proficiency bonus.

featureCatalogue.name: Preacher level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Preacher; Once per long rest, as an action, up to three allies within 30 ft regain hit points equal to 2d6 + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier.

featureCatalogue.name: Preacher level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Preacher; Allies within 30 ft also gain +1d4 to fear saves.

featureCatalogue.name: Preacher level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Preacher; Allies within 30 ft gain advantage on fear saves while you are conscious.

featureCatalogue.name: Preacher level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Preacher; When you use Martyr’s Mercy, the target also gains advantage on its next saving throw against fear.

featureCatalogue.name: Purifier level 14
featureCatalogue.description: Purifier; Your fire damage ignores resistance, and daemons/corrupted creatures cannot regain hit points until the start of your next turn after taking your fire damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Purifier level 18
featureCatalogue.description: Purifier; When you deal fire damage, one affected creature cannot benefit from cover against your next attack before your next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Purifier level 3
featureCatalogue.description: Purifier; You gain proficiency with flamers. Once per turn, fire damage you deal ignores resistance.

featureCatalogue.name: Purifier level 7
featureCatalogue.description: Purifier; Your flamer and firebomb damage increases by +1 per damage die against daemons, heretics, mutants, and corrupted creatures.

featureCatalogue.name: Aeldari Grace
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Aeldari Grace
Requirement: Aeldari
Benefit: Your speed increases by 5 ft while wearing light or Aeldari armour.

featureCatalogue.name: Alien Reflexes
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Alien Reflexes
Requirement: Aeldari
Benefit: Once per short rest, when an enemy misses you with an attack, move 5 ft without provoking opportunity attacks.

featureCatalogue.name: Ancestor’s Grudge
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Ancestor’s Grudge
Requirement: Squat/Kin
Benefit: Once per short rest, when a creature damages you, mark it. Your next hit against it deals +1d6 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Armour Familiarity
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Armour Familiarity
Benefit: While wearing armour you are proficient with, reduce incoming damage from non-critical weapon attacks by 1.

featureCatalogue.name: Bayonet Fighter
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Bayonet Fighter
Benefit: When wielding a basic firearm in two hands, you may make a 1d6 piercing melee attack with it.

featureCatalogue.name: Bigger Gun
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Bigger Gun
Requirement: Ogryn
Benefit: You can wield one Heavy weapon without disadvantage from moving.

featureCatalogue.name: Bone ’ead Implant
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Bone ’ead Implant
Requirement: Ogryn
Benefit: Increase Intelligence by 1, maximum 12. You gain proficiency in Wisdom saves or one skill.

featureCatalogue.name: Brawler
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Brawler
Benefit: Your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 damage, or 1d8 if both hands are free.

featureCatalogue.name: Breacher
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Breacher
Benefit: You have advantage on checks to force doors, smash barricades, and breach weak bulkheads. Your first attack against an object deals +1d8 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Close-Quarters Killer
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Close-Quarters Killer
Benefit: You do not suffer disadvantage when making ranged attacks within 5 ft.

featureCatalogue.name: Cold Logic
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Cold Logic
Requirement: Skitarii
Benefit: Once per long rest, treat a failed Wisdom saving throw against fear, charm, or psychic manipulation as a success.

featureCatalogue.name: Combat Medic
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Combat Medic
Benefit: As an action, restore 1d6 + proficiency bonus HP to an adjacent creature. Uses equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

featureCatalogue.name: Cook’s Morale
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Cook’s Morale
Requirement: Ratling
Benefit: During a short rest, cook or brew something edible. Up to five allies regain +1 extra hit point per Hit Die spent.

featureCatalogue.name: Crisis Runner
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Crisis Runner
Benefit: When you Dash, difficult terrain caused by rubble, crowds, gantries, wreckage, or industrial clutter costs no extra movement.

featureCatalogue.name: Cybernetic Implant
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Cybernetic Implant
Benefit: Gain one minor augmetic upgrade.

featureCatalogue.name: Dead Calm
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Dead Calm
Benefit: Once per short rest, ignore disadvantage on one ranged attack caused by Suppression, fear, smoke, darkness, or battlefield chaos.

featureCatalogue.name: Field Armourer
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Field Armourer
Benefit: During a short rest, repair one damaged weapon or restore one use of a shield, field, or armour feature at the GM's discretion.

featureCatalogue.name: Grenadier
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Grenadier
Benefit: Grenade save DCs increase by +1. You can throw grenades 20 ft farther.

featureCatalogue.name: Heavy Weapon Training
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Heavy Weapon Training
Benefit: You ignore the movement penalty from Heavy weapons.

featureCatalogue.name: Hip Fire
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Hip Fire
Benefit: After moving at least 10 ft, make one pistol attack as a bonus action.

featureCatalogue.name: Hive-Blooded
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Hive-Blooded
Requirement: Human or Ratling
Benefit: You have advantage on checks to navigate hive districts, underhive markets, vents, hab-blocks, sump routes, and gang territory.

featureCatalogue.name: Hold-Born Engineer
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Hold-Born Engineer
Requirement: Squat/Kin
Benefit: Gain proficiency in Technology or an engineering tool. You have advantage on checks to repair, breach, mine, or salvage machinery.

featureCatalogue.name: Imperial Flexibility
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Imperial Flexibility
Requirement: Human
Benefit: Gain proficiency in one skill, tool, or weapon group.

featureCatalogue.name: Impossible Shot
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Impossible Shot
Requirement: Ratling
Benefit: Once per short rest, ignore cover on one ranged attack.

featureCatalogue.name: Iron Discipline
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Iron Discipline
Benefit: Advantage on saving throws against fear and Suppression.

featureCatalogue.name: Iron Stance
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Iron Stance
Requirement: Squat/Kin
Benefit: If you move no more than half your speed on your turn, you gain +1 AC until your next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Kin Weapon Master
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Kin Weapon Master
Requirement: Squat/Kin
Benefit: Gain +1 damage with Kin weapons.

featureCatalogue.name: Last Order Standing
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Last Order Standing
Requirement: Human
Benefit: Once per long rest, when an ally within 30 ft drops to 0 hit points, you gain temporary HP equal to your level + proficiency bonus.

featureCatalogue.name: Loyal as Stone
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Loyal as Stone
Requirement: Ogryn
Benefit: When an ally within 5 ft fails a death save, you may use your reaction to let them reroll it.

featureCatalogue.name: Machine Precision
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Machine Precision
Requirement: Skitarii
Benefit: Once per short rest, add your Intelligence modifier to a weapon damage roll.

featureCatalogue.name: Noospheric Burst
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Noospheric Burst
Requirement: Skitarii
Benefit: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, choose one ally within 60 ft. Their next attack gains +1d4 to hit.

featureCatalogue.name: Ogryn Wall
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Ogryn Wall
Requirement: Ogryn
Benefit: Allies behind you gain light cover while you are not incapacitated.

featureCatalogue.name: Path Discipline
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Path Discipline
Requirement: Aeldari
Benefit: Once per long rest, reroll a failed Wisdom or Dexterity saving throw.

featureCatalogue.name: Pocket Marksman
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Pocket Marksman
Requirement: Ratling
Benefit: When prone or behind cover, your first ranged attack each turn deals +1 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Point Blank Execution
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Point Blank Execution
Benefit: Once per short rest, when you hit a target within 5 ft with a pistol or shotgun, add 1d6 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Rad-Hardened
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Rad-Hardened
Requirement: Skitarii
Benefit: Resistance to poison or radiation damage. Advantage on saves against radiation, toxins, and disease.

featureCatalogue.name: Ranger’s Cloak
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Ranger’s Cloak
Requirement: Aeldari Outcast
Benefit: You may hide when lightly obscured by ruins, foliage, smoke, shadow, or battlefield debris.

featureCatalogue.name: Rapid Reload
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Rapid Reload
Benefit: Reload basic weapons as a bonus action instead of an action.

featureCatalogue.name: Ratling Vanish
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Ratling Vanish
Requirement: Ratling
Benefit: When you take damage, use your reaction to move 10 ft without provoking opportunity attacks.

featureCatalogue.name: Relic-Bearer
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Relic-Bearer
Benefit: You carry a minor relic, oath-token, saint bone, engraved casing, or machine charm. Once per long rest, add 1d4 to a saving throw after seeing the roll.

featureCatalogue.name: Sacred Augmetics
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Sacred Augmetics
Requirement: Skitarii
Benefit: When you regain hit points during a short rest, regain additional HP equal to your proficiency bonus.

featureCatalogue.name: Sanctioning Scars
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Sanctioning Scars
Requirement: Human Psyker
Benefit: When you trigger Perils, reduce the psychic damage you take from that Peril’s result by your proficiency bonus.

featureCatalogue.name: Scavver’s Luck
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Scavver’s Luck
Requirement: Ratling
Benefit: Once per long rest, declare that you packed a small mundane item worth 25 throne gelt or less.

featureCatalogue.name: Suppressive Discipline
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Suppressive Discipline
Benefit: When you force a Suppression save, increase the DC by 1.

featureCatalogue.name: Tactical Reposition
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Tactical Reposition
Benefit: When you take the Disengage action, one ally within 5 ft may move 5 ft without provoking opportunity attacks.

featureCatalogue.name: Too Angry to Notice
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Too Angry to Notice
Requirement: Ogryn
Benefit: Once per short rest, reduce psychic, poison, or necrotic damage by 1d12 + Constitution modifier.

featureCatalogue.name: Void Stock
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Void Stock
Requirement: Squat/Kin
Benefit: Advantage on saves against vacuum exposure, suffocation, toxic atmosphere, and exhaustion from poor conditions.

featureCatalogue.name: Weapon Specialist
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Weapon Specialist
Benefit: Choose one weapon group: pistols, basic firearms, sniper weapons, shotguns, chain weapons, shock weapons, plasma, melta, or heavy weapons. Gain +1 damage with that group.

featureCatalogue.name: Witch-Sight
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Witch-Sight
Requirement: Human Psyker
Benefit: You can sense active psychic effects, daemonic influence, and Warp residue within 30 ft.

featureCatalogue.name: Witchblade Adept
featureCatalogue.description:
Talent: Witchblade Adept
Requirement: Aeldari Warlock
Benefit: Add +1 damage with witchblades and singing spears; these weapons count as psychic for overcoming resistance.

featureCatalogue.name: Augmetic Scarred
featureCatalogue.description:
Trait: Augmetic Scarred
Effect: Gain one minor augmetic upgrade. You suffer disadvantage on Persuasion checks with groups that distrust obvious cybernetics.

featureCatalogue.name: Black-Market Eye
featureCatalogue.description:
Trait: Black-Market Eye
Effect: Gain proficiency in Investigation or Insight. Advantage on checks to assess the value, legality or likely source of weapons, relics, chems and contraband.

featureCatalogue.name: Chem-Hardened
featureCatalogue.description:
Trait: Chem-Hardened
Effect: Advantage on saving throws against poison, disease and combat drugs.

featureCatalogue.name: Devoted Servant
featureCatalogue.description:
Trait: Devoted Servant
Effect: Once per long rest, when you fail a death saving throw, treat it as a success instead.

featureCatalogue.name: Dirty Pragmatist
featureCatalogue.description:
Trait: Dirty Pragmatist
Effect: Gain proficiency in Deception or Sleight of Hand. Once per short rest, draw, conceal, palm or plant a small item without requiring an action.

featureCatalogue.name: Faith in Steel
featureCatalogue.description:
Trait: Faith in Steel
Effect: While wearing armour, once per long rest, reduce incoming damage by your proficiency bonus.

featureCatalogue.name: Faithful
featureCatalogue.description:
Trait: Faithful
Effect: Once per long rest, when you fail a Wisdom or Charisma saving throw, reroll it. You must use the new result.

featureCatalogue.name: Field Chirurgeon
featureCatalogue.description:
Trait: Field Chirurgeon
Effect: Gain proficiency in Medicine. Once per short rest, stabilise a creature as a bonus action rather than an action.

featureCatalogue.name: Grudge-Bearer
featureCatalogue.description:
Trait: Grudge-Bearer
Effect: Choose heretics, mutants, daemons, xenos, gangers or traitor soldiers. Once per long rest, when you hit that category, add 1d6 damage.

featureCatalogue.name: Hard to Kill
featureCatalogue.description:
Trait: Hard to Kill
Effect: Maximum HP increases by 2; advantage on death saves while an ally is within 5 ft.

featureCatalogue.name: Hive Survivor
featureCatalogue.description:
Trait: Hive Survivor
Effect: Gain proficiency in Survival or Stealth. Advantage on checks to find shelter, water, food or safe routes in hive, ruin, sump or industrial terrain.

featureCatalogue.name: Iron Nerves
featureCatalogue.description:
Trait: Iron Nerves
Effect: Once per short rest, when you would become Suppressed, ignore the condition until the start of your next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Jaded
featureCatalogue.description:
Trait: Jaded
Effect: Advantage on saving throws against fear caused by gore, death, torture, corruption or battlefield horror.

featureCatalogue.name: Knife in the Boot
featureCatalogue.description:
Trait: Knife in the Boot
Effect: You count as having a concealed knife or improvised shiv unless fully searched. Gain proficiency with knives.

featureCatalogue.name: Litany-Marked
featureCatalogue.description:
Trait: Litany-Marked
Effect: Once per long rest, as a bonus action, you and one ally within 30 ft gain advantage on saves against fear until the start of your next turn.

featureCatalogue.name: Munitorum Drilled
featureCatalogue.description:
Trait: Munitorum Drilled
Effect: Gain proficiency with one basic firearm. Once per short rest, reload a basic weapon without spending an action.

featureCatalogue.name: Touched by the Warp
featureCatalogue.description:
Trait: Touched by the Warp
Effect: Human only. Know one Minor Universal Psychic Power. Using it increases Warp Pressure by 1 and risks Perils. Skitarii cannot take this trait.

featureCatalogue.name: Twitchy
featureCatalogue.description:
Trait: Twitchy
Effect: Gain +2 to initiative.

featureCatalogue.name: Unnaturally Lucky
featureCatalogue.description:
Trait: Unnaturally Lucky
Effect: Once per long rest, reroll any d20 roll. You must use the new result.

featureCatalogue.name: Vox Familiar
featureCatalogue.description:
Trait: Vox Familiar
Effect: Allies within 120 ft with vox access can understand your short coded messages even in combat noise.
